Wow, I can’t believe this is episode 2 of the Letters Page Podcast!

No, this whiny bro voice bit is comedy gold.

Benchmark is the oven-toasted brussels sprout of Sentinel Comics.

I need an image of this broccoli-loving radical fox now. I wonder if he’s friends with Gun Rat?

Who knew Benchmark was an influencer? Though clearly, he’s the new standard for influencers.

I’m glad I figured out Setback as the most likely to take money from Revocorp because he needs it. Ra is a considerably funnier choice, however.

“Wow, this sucks” I’m so glad they’re having fun, because I am too.

Feels like Benchmark vs. Adhesivist would be a pretty one-sided fight, huh? God, what a great cameo though.

Gotta say, I wasn’t notably jazzed for this issue, but I had a lot of fun with it! B+!

Ooh, Benchmark confirmed for Definitive Edition! And more than one expansion left, too!

Writer’s Room: Setback fights an Argent Adept villain, someone make it happen!

So you could say there’s one ring to guide them all, and in their bloodline, bind them.

I neither needed to hear or see it, I knew Christopher was doing the walking-into-the-basement bit. XD

Adam doesn’t have any cats yet.

Oh wow, they actually confirmed more than 6 boxes. I was just kind of joking there!

posts.cooked:
I can’t say I’m exactly elated by the news that they’re expanding the DE roadmap. I feel like the initially planned content would’ve been more than enough to keep myself, personally, satisfied, with enough breadth that it would never get old. (Though I do acknowledge that there are many who play much more frequently than myself and thus might desire more content, and also that there are those for whom more content is simply always more better.) I also would have thought that the past year would have made GTG more appreciative of every chance they get to make something, and so focus on essentials, rather than add extraneous things.

There’s also the thought that extending the lifetime of SotM DE likely also means putting off focusing on the RPG even more, but I suppose it’s most prudent to assume that that ship has sailed long ago. Although I do wonder — perhaps they intend to make DE something of an evergreen product? That is, perhaps the company’s financial problems arose, in part, because there was a period when they stopped releasing new SotM products, and so they plan on continually releasing them for the foreseeable future. On reflexion, I don’t think that hypothesis is particularly likely to be true, since IIRC they were also releasing Spirit Island things during that time, which of course was far more successful and profitable than any Sentinel products.

posts.cooked:
Welp, so much for my plan to eventually review the entire podcast backward and forward.

The way you make broccoli cool is the Ant Man and the Wasp Colony Quantumania character Broccoli Man. I will buy any comic book that has him on the cover.

Pretty sure TikTok was still called Vine in 2016.

I think it might be Captain Cosmic who does the phone call. Ra is a stretch, but Hugh is maintaining a secret identity as a lawyer while not actually practicing law, he could easily find himself strapped for cash to pay the next YEAR of rent and bills on his flat, in case he gets lost in space again.

I could get really into the psychology of a character like Benchmark with the kid asking about Legacy; I could see his narration box making some commentary about how Legacy does the right thing but he’s a little old fashioned and cheesy in his earnestness, while Randall does the right thing but he’s doing this crass commercialism and tacky promotional stunts.
